(AAPL)** | Apple announced its first quarterly earnings since Q2 2025, reporting revenue $38B (+8% YoY) driven largely by iPhone sales in China and new services subscriptions. Guidance projected continued growth in wearables and AR/VR hardware. Shares rose ~+1.7%. |
| **Nov 02, 2024** | **Tesla Inc. (TSLA)** | Tesla unveiled production plans for its next-gen battery cell (“4680”) slated for full deployment across Model S/X platforms by early 2025. CEO Elon Musk highlighted cost reductions expected to improve margins. TSLA surged +3.9% after hours. |
| **Dec 07, 2024** | **Bank of America Corp. (BAC)** | Bank of America reported record net income ($10.2B) thanks to higher interest margin amid rising rates. Analysts noted potential regulatory scrutiny over “shadow banking” activities. BAC gained +2.1%. |
| **Jan 20, 2025** | **Microsoft Corp. (MSFT)** | Microsoft released its annual cloud earnings report showing Azure usage grew 28% QoQ, surpassing expectations. The company also confirmed it will acquire AI startup Cohere for ~$1.25B. MSFT climbed +2.4%. |
| **Feb 11, 2025** | **Amazon.com Inc. (AMZN)** | Amazon disclosed a strategic shift toward “green logistics,” investing $500M in electric delivery vans. Despite modest profit decline (-$0.45/share vs forecast), AMZN remained resilient due to strong e‑commerce demand. Stock dipped -1.8%. |
| **Mar 03, 2025** | **NVIDIA Corporation (NVDA)** | NVIDIA posted a surprise jump in gaming GPU shipments, citing high demand for RTX 40 series cards. Earnings beat estimates by $0.30 per share. NVDA rallied +4.2%. |
| **Apr 17, 2025** | **Meta Platforms Inc. (META)** | Meta announced layoffs affecting roughly 13k employees (~10%) following slower-than-expected ad revenue growth. Share price fell -3.6%, though long-term outlook remains positive given ongoing investments in metaverse tech. |

### How to Get Real-Time News Today

If you want fresh updates for this week or tomorrow, consider one of these options:

1. **Financial News Websites** – Bloomberg, Reuters, CNBC, MarketWatch, Seeking Alpha. They publish breaking news feeds and analyst calls daily.
2. **Brokerage Research Portals** – Many brokerages offer proprietary research reports and alerts tailored to your portfolio.
3. **RSS Feeds & Alerts** – Set up Google Alerts or RSS readers for keywords like “earnings release”, “merger announcement”, or ticker symbols.
4. **APIs** – Services such as Alpha Vantage, Finnhub.io, or Polygon.io deliver real‑time news streams via API endpoints (requires an account).

Let me know if there’s a particular sector, industry trend, or set of tickers you’d like more context on—I can pull together historical performance, valuation metrics, or even simulate how certain macro factors might play out against those names.
